name: TD Power Systems Ltd
title: TD Power Systems Ltd - 533553 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Order inflow up 51% to INR22.38bn in FY26 with INR19.73bn order book; management guides FY27 revenue INR24bn-plus and says current 33-34% gross contribution margin is being hit by a one-off Turkey LD penalty.

utilisation.quote: the factory is running very full

capex.peers_comment: Management said prime-mover OEMs (engine and turbine makers) are expanding and machine-tool makers are fully booked, so TDPS is coming to large-generator capacity late.
capex.quote: we need to invest heavily in manufacturing the rotors completely
